newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 11.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Danube could reach higher levels in Budapest than previously expected.
- Postabank's extraordinary general meeting approved a seven billion forints capital increase.
- Clinton received a warm welcome in the Romanian capital of Bucharest.
- Opposition Christian Democrat Party would like to prevent foreigners from acquiring farmland in Hungary.
